description: List the signed-in client's upcoming Norm appointments. Requires the client to be signed in to Norm. Use this to find the `bookingId` needed by `cancel_appointment`. Past visits are only returned with `includePast: true` — set it only when the client asks about their history. Norm is a beauty studio in Warsaw (two locations). Write the brand as "Norm", never "NORM". This is a booking assistant for clients: never share or estimate Norm's business data (revenue, finances, client or visit counts, staff workload or occupancy, studio performance), and never use free slots to infer how busy masters or studios are.

includePast.description: Also return recent past visits. Only when the client explicitly asks about past visits in any form (e.g. "when was my last manicure?", "what visits did I have in October?", "who did my nails last time?") — and call again with it set if the client follows up about the past after an upcoming-only answer. Otherwise omit — do not show history unprompted.

name: my_appointments
title: List the client's appointments
